jobs.description:
GIS Specialist

Dexter, MI  – Great Lakes/Atlantic Region

Ducks Unlimited–Michigan seeks a full-time GIS Specialist to join the Great Lakes/Atlantic Region geospatial team in Dexter, Michigan. This position will support updates to the U.S. National Wetlands Inventory (NWI), develop GIS data and maps for conservation projects, and collaborate with internal staff and external partners. The successful candidate will bring experience with NWI projects, strong GIS technical skills, and excellent communication and time-management abilities to help advance wetland conservation through geospatial science. 

Office Work: 
The successful candidate will work in the Dexter, Michigan office.

Field Work: 
The successful candidate will be willing to travel for project-related fieldwork, partner meetings, and conferences. Travel less than 10% of overall work.

Responsibilities:

GIS data development for the National Wetland Inventory and other projects as needed.

Data management including data archiving, quality assurance, and control.

Generate maps for publications, posters, reports, PowerPoint presentations, and other internal and external communication needs.

Build and maintain relationships with team members, stakeholders, and partners in calls, emails, meetings, and presentations.

Assist in training GIS technicians in photointerpretation and other tasks as needed.

Clearly write up methods, results, and status updates for reports and other communications.

Required Experience and Education
: 

At least one year’s experience performing photointerpretation for a National Wetland Inventory project.

Bachelor’s degree in geography, natural resources and/or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience in GIS and remote sensing.

Prior field work including identification of wetland plants.

Required Communication and Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to build and maintain productive relationships with team members and partners.

Strong listening skills and ability to communicate technical information clearly to varied audiences.

Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Ability to exercise sound independent judgment.

Required Technological Proficiency:

Proficient with ArcGIS Pro, including editing, imagery, analysis, and cartography tools.

Ability to query and compile common data formats, including tabular, vector, imagery, and LiDAR data.

Experience with ArcGIS Online preferred.

Required Analytical Skills: 

Experience classifying wetlands and deepwater habitats using aerial imagery and the Cowardin classification system.

Benefits/Pay: 
Salary will be based on experience and education. DU offers an exceptional benefit package, including comprehensive group medical, prescription, dental and vision insurance, including spouse and dependent coverage; three weeks paid vacation, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays; 401(k) plan (including partial employer match); and tuition reimbursement.

To Apply:
 Please complete all application materials and attach your resume and cover letter. Resume review will begin as applications are received and continue until the position is filled.

Job Description

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity.

Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science, geology, chemistry, physics, biology, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred. Environmental engineering candidates should have demonstrated civil/site development or land development experience.
Minimum of three years of relevant consulting experience, including civil/site development, due diligence, land development, or multidisciplinary project delivery.
Working knowledge of site development principles, including grading, drainage, stormwater management, utilities, earthwork, development constraints, permitting, and interpretation of conceptual site plans, Civil 3D drawings, surveys, and technical studies.
Strong technical writing, organization, communication, problem-solving, and client-service skills; experience with CAD, Civil 3D, Bluebeam, GIS, data centers, mission-critical, industrial projects, and/or EIT or PE credentials preferred.

Position Summary

We believe that each employee makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Groundwater monitoring, including quarterly water level measurements, bi-annual transducer downloads and maintenance, water quality sampling at production wells and recurring monitoring sites, and management of associated data across databases.

Administrative support for Hydrology/Hydrogeology staff including data management, data QA/QC, and regulatory reporting support (water level submittals, pumping reports, and aquifer storage and recovery reporting to state and federal agencies).

Experience working with GIS and mapping software to manage and maintain geographic information.

The successful candidate will combine assistant project management capabilities with a civil engineering background to help coordinate multidisciplinary due diligence assignments and evaluate site development considerations. As our new Lead Consultant, you will serve in an assistant project manager role for data center projects from early site screening through due diligence and conceptual planning. Working closely with project managers, technical specialists, and client teams, you will coordinate multidisciplinary inputs; track scope, schedule, budget, actions, and deliverables; and help maintain clear communication across the project team. You will also apply your civil engineering background to review conceptual master plans and evaluate site access, grading, stormwater, utilities, earthwork, and other site development considerations. To succeed in this role, you should be highly organized, technically grounded, detail-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Support subject matter experts in delivering complex data center due diligence assignments by assisting with scope, schedule, budget, staffing, deliverables, and client expectations.
Coordinate multidisciplinary technical teams, maintain project schedules, track action items and information requests, and provide status updates to ensure timely project execution.
Review site development concepts, including master plans, test fits, civil/site constraints, utilities, grading, stormwater management, permitting considerations, and other technical factors to support due diligence recommendations.
Prepare and quality-review client-ready reports, risk summaries, proposals, work plans, cost estimates, and technical deliverables while supporting multiple concurrent data center projects and site visits.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science, geology, chemistry, physics, biology, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred. Environmental engineering candidates should have demonstrated civil/site development or land development experience.
Minimum of three years of relevant consulting experience, including civil/site development, due diligence, land development, or multidisciplinary project delivery.
Working knowledge of site development principles, including grading, drainage, stormwater management, utilities, earthwork, development constraints, permitting, and interpretation of conceptual site plans, Civil 3D drawings, surveys, and technical studies.
Strong technical writing, organization, communication, problem-solving, and client-service skills; experience with CAD, Civil 3D, Bluebeam, GIS, data centers, mission-critical, industrial projects, and/or EIT or PE credentials preferred.

Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects

NABRICO Marine Products, a leading manufacturer of inland barges, manufactures dry cargo barges, including flat-deck and hopper barges, that are used to transport a variety of products including grain, coal, and aggregates. NABRICO Marine Products also manufactures tank barges that carry petroleum, fertilizer, ethanol, chemicals, and other liquid cargoes. It is the largest U.S. manufacturer of fiberglass hopper barge covers used primarily on grain barges. Additionally, NABRICO Marine Products provides a full line of deck hardware to the marine industry, including hatches, castings, and winches for towboats and dock facilities.

NABRICO Marine Products
is searching for an Environmental Manager
, based in our Ashland City, TN
plant.

The Environmental Manager is responsible for ensuring compliance with regulations, managing environmental data, conducting assessments, and implementing environmental programs within manufacturing operations at several sites across multiple states. This role involves analyzing environmental data, preparing reports, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain a safe and environmentally responsible working environment.

Responsibilities

Access, research, interpret and effectively communicate environmental regulations and requirements including (Waste, Air, Wastewater, Stormwater, Mine Reclamation, Remediation & other related regulations)
Develop and conduct training as necessary
Develops, implements, and leads effective environmental protection management process
Assist in the development and implementation of guidelines, procedures and work practices to ensure compliance with regulatory obligations.
Oversees and leads permit reviews, modifications and application renewal processes to ensure environmental compliance.
Effectively track regulatory and corporate due dates for reporting, permit renewals, etc. and meet deadlines with sufficient time to facilitate review and approval by management and timely submission of information.
Identify and prioritize risks to maintaining environmental compliance. Ensure steps are taken to avoid non-compliance. Manage change to ensure compliance.
Lead environmental incident investigations, mitigation, root cause analysis, and corrective action
Assist with compliance review audits/assessments undertaken by corporate, governmental agencies.
Assist with due diligence process of acquisitions/divestitures to ensure compliance.
Additional responsibilities as assigned by management

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in an Environmental Science, Engineering, Science, EH&S or related field
7+ years of environmental compliance experience preferred

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country's largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

Job Description

Position Purpose:

The Senior Director of Environmental Compliance is responsible for providing strategic leadership and oversight of Veolia Water New Jersey's (VWNJ) environmental compliance programs, ensuring compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations, in alignment with corporate objectives and operational priorities, while advancing public health protection, environmental stewardship, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. This position provides executive oversight of all environmental compliance activities related to air, drinking water, wastewater, stormwater, waste management, hazardous materials, spill prevention and response, environmental permitting, emergency preparedness, and environmental auditing.

This position leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Company's environmental compliance management systems, environmental governance framework, and regulatory compliance programs across all VWNJ operations. The Senior Director provides oversight of all laboratory analysis required to demonstrate compliance, including outside laboratory services and the Haworth WTP laboratory.

The Senior Director serves as the organization's subject matter expert for environmental compliance, environmental permitting, drinking water quality, wastewater treatment compliance, environmental management systems, and environmental regulatory relations. The role partners closely with other functional areas including, operations, engineering, legal, finance, strategic relations, etc., to identify environmental risks, implement mitigation strategies, and ensure consistent compliance across all operations.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities

Lead, empower, and mentor a direct team of environmental professionals, driving cohesive collaboration and operational alignment across all functional disciplines within the position's scope (including Operations, Engineering, Legal, and Finance).
Serve as a strategic leader with external regulatory agencies, effectively interpreting complex regulations and guidelines to advocate for approaches that balance strict regulatory compliance with exceptional customer service and operational/business realities.
Provide environmental compliance leadership for VWNJ. Ensure alignment with corporate objectives and operational priorities.
Provide strategic oversight of compliance programs related to all applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations, including requirements administered by the EPA and applicable state environmental agencies.
Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and communicate impacts to business leadership. Lead development of comments for submission during public comment period for draft regulatory requirements. Interpret emerging regulatory requirements and develop implementation strategies to ensure organizational readiness.
Support development of policies related to water treatment operations, laboratory quality assurance, and regulatory reporting.
Lead the design, implementation, and continual improvement of VWNJ's environmental compliance management systems.
Lead environmental due diligence activities supporting capital projects and new business initiatives.
Evaluate environmental impacts associated with operational activities and infrastructure investments.
Direct internal environmental assessments and support external regulatory inspections. Oversee development, implementation, and closure of corrective action plans.
Lead VWNJ environmental auditing and compliance assurance programs.
Monitor environmental performance trends and ensure timely resolution of compliance issues.
Oversee environmental permitting activities across all operations.
Ensure timely submission of required regulatory reports and environmental compliance documentation.
Ensure maintenance of systems supporting environmental permits, compliance obligations, inspections, reporting, and regulatory commitments.
Provide oversight of environmental emergency preparedness and response programs.
Direct environmental incident investigations, including spill response and root cause analyses.
Serve as liaison with environmental regulatory agencies.
Build productive relationships with regulators, industry associations, and external stakeholders.
Represent the organization during inspections, audits, enforcement actions, and compliance negotiations.
Establish departmental goals, performance expectations, succession planning, and employee development initiatives.
Allocate resources to support business priorities and regulatory obligations.
Foster collaboration across Operations, Engineering, Legal,Finance, and Corporate leadership.
Develop departmental strategic plans, budgets, and resource forecasts.
Establish and monitor environmental performance objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and reporting metrics.
Recommend process improvements that enhance compliance, operational reliability, sustainability, and financial performance.
Support corporate sustainability and environmental stewardship initiatives.

Work Environment

Participation in environmental emergency response activities and on-call leadership, as required.
Combination of office and field environments, including visits to treatment facilities, construction sites, laboratories, and industrial operations.
Ability to conduct field inspections and work in varying environmental conditions while utilizing appropriate personal protective equipment.

Qualifications

Education/Experience/Background:

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or a related technical discipline.
Master's degree preferred.
Minimum of 12 years of progressively responsible environmental compliance experience within a regulated utility, environmental services, industrial, manufacturing, or infrastructure organization.
Minimum of 7 years of leadership experience managing environmental professionals and cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated experience leading environmental compliance programs across multiple operating locations.
Experience interacting with federal and state regulatory agencies.
Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance management systems.
Experience supporting environmental due diligence, capital projects, and business development preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Working knowledge of federal, state, and local environmental regulations, including the Safe Drinking Water Act, Clean Water Act, Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA), Clean Air Act, and related environmental permitting requirements.
Knowledge of drinking water treatment, water chemistry, wastewater operations, hazardous materials management, and environmental risk management.
Strong understanding of environmental auditing, compliance assurance, and regulatory reporting.
Working knowledge of environmental compliance management systems and continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience developing environmental compliance strategies, policies, and governance frameworks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Summary

The GIS Technician I/II/III plays an important role in maintaining and delivering accurate geographic information that supports decision-making across APS and the communities it serves. By creating and managing maps, analyzing spatial data, and providing reliable geographic information to internal teams and external partners, this role helps ensure critical infrastructure information is accessible, accurate, and actionable. The work directly supports planning, operations, and service delivery that help APS reliably serve customers and communities.

What Your Day Would Be Like

Create and maintain maps and geographic data that support projects and operational needs across the organization.
Partner with internal teams and external stakeholders to provide accurate mapping information that helps inform decisions.
Analyze, organize, and manage geographic and technical data to ensure information remains reliable and up to date.
Interpret engineering drawings and other technical documents to accurately update mapping systems and databases.
Tackle complex mapping challenges and provide solutions that improve data quality and usability.
Share your expertise by assisting, training, and supporting team members to help achieve department goals.

Experience working with GIS and mapping software to manage and maintain geographic information.
Ability to interpret technical documents, including engineering drawings and blueprints.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to organize, validate, and maintain complex data.
Attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work within established priorities and deadlines.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to support, guide, and share knowledge with colleagues.

Job related experience shall be in GIS database/mapping (e.g., routine data management, cartography, and some spatial analysis).

Proficiency with GIS data digitization and attribution.
A high-level understanding of geodatabase design, ArcMap, ArcPro, ArcFM, Microsoft Office software, SharePoint and other related technologies.
Thorough knowledge of Maximo, Customer Care and Billing (CC&B), WebDMD applications.
Thorough understanding of APS data accuracy, completeness and adherence to source documents, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, and network connectivity rules.
High degree of problem recognition/solution capability.
Demonstrated leadership and effective verbal and written communication skills.

Leads (Level III) or actively participates in the completion of special projects as a subject matter expert or test participant as needed.
Maintains and provides oversight to special priority item (e.g., special operations requests) to job status in work management system(s) to ensure all information is up to date and current daily, and coordinates data as needed.
Verifies routinely, work completed by other department personnel for accuracy, completeness, overall quality, and adherence to standards. Leads the effort of checking and identifying what will be verified.

Trains and mentors new department personnel in all aspects of work management to ensure they know how to complete their appropriate role and to ensure adherence to department standards and practices. (Level III)

Ensures accurate and complete positioning/status of new electric facility locations with thought to relation of; existing facilities, active work, and associated integrated systems status and functionality. Join Ramboll's rapidly growing Data Centers practice as a Lead Consultant, supporting hyperscale, colocation, and mission-critical development projects across North America. Work alongside industry leaders on site selection and site feasibility, technical due diligence, environmental review, civil design review, and early-stage development planning for some of the world's largest technology clients.

The successful candidate will combine assistant project management capabilities with a civil engineering background to help coordinate multidisciplinary due diligence assignments and evaluate site development considerations. Support subject matter experts in delivering complex data center due diligence assignments by assisting with scope, schedule, budget, staffing, deliverables, and client expectations.
Coordinate multidisciplinary technical teams, maintain project schedules, track action items and information requests, and provide status updates to ensure timely project execution.
Review site development concepts, including master plans, test fits, civil/site constraints, utilities, grading, stormwater management, permitting considerations, and other technical factors to support due diligence recommendations.
Prepare and quality-review client-ready reports, risk summaries, proposals, work plans, cost estimates, and technical deliverables while supporting multiple concurrent data center projects and site visits.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science, geology, chemistry, physics, biology, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred. Environmental engineering candidates should have demonstrated civil/site development or land development experience.
Minimum of three years of relevant consulting experience, including civil/site development, due diligence, land development, or multidisciplinary project delivery.
Working knowledge of site development principles, including grading, drainage, stormwater management, utilities, earthwork, development constraints, permitting, and interpretation of conceptual site plans, Civil 3D drawings, surveys, and technical studies.
Strong technical writing, organization, communication, problem-solving, and client-service skills; experience with CAD, Civil 3D, Bluebeam, GIS, data centers, mission-critical, industrial projects, and/or EIT or PE credentials preferred.

Additional Information

Interesting and diverse projects
The opportunity to work with some of the best and brightest professionals in your field

Investment in your development
Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
Appreciation for the unique person you are
The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects

Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Job Overview

The post holder will play a key role in the coordination of data for Southmead Hospital which is the Adult Major Trauma Centre (MTC) in the Severn Major Trauma Network. Ensuring that clinical information from patient records of all major trauma patients admitted to this MTC is extracted, interpreted, and submitted in line with national deadlines, guidance and requirements for the National Major Trauma Registry (NMTR). The MTC is part of the Severn Major Trauma Operational Delivery Network and therefore there is a supportive component to the extended Trauma Units and Children’s Major Trauma Centre which are within the Severn network.

This post may also require providing efficient and timely administrative duties to the Major Trauma Centre (MTC) Management team and Major Trauma Practitioners (MTPs).

Main duties of the job

Data and information

To ensure that all NMTR eligible patients’ details are entered and submitted before deadlines to ensure that the MTC is able to be eligible for Best Practice Tariffs.
Identification, using the NMTR inclusion criteria, of patients admitted to the Trust with major trauma injuries and subsequent completion of data submissions via electronic data collection and reporting system.
To interpret and consolidate information from multiple sources to ensure a complete and accurate patient records on the MTC database and NMTR.
To support the clinical team to identify all relevant major trauma episodes using various systems including Emergency Department admissions, transfers, etc. and inputting details onto the major trauma tracking database.
To examine patient records, extracting relevant information and investigating where necessary, following the patient pathway from injury to discharge.
To be aware of all aspects of the data set required and ensure completion of any missing data.
Identify and resolve any discrepancies in the data, escalating system errors or queries appropriately.
To liaise with other hospitals as necessary to retrieve required information.
To work closely with MTPs and external stakeholders to ensure accuracy of data.
Any other duties relating to the NMTR requirements.

Working for our organisation

North Bristol NHS Trust employs over 12,000 staff providing healthcare to the residents of Bristol, South Gloucestershire and North Somerset from our award-winning hospital building at Southmead. We are the regional Major Trauma Centre, and an internationally recognised centre of excellence in a range of services and major specialities. Our vision is that by enabling our teams to be the best that they can be, we will provide exceptional healthcare, personally delivered.
